B85 Audio browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal B85 Audio Hrom - Bass Overdrive Published on January 25, 2025 B85 Audio overdrive Bluetooth pedal Information B85 Audio B85 audio Hrom is a floor effect built on the CD4049UBE CMOS chip, on which analog overdrivers from renowned manufacturers such as Darkglass B3K, Darkglass Vintage, etc. are built... This effect is based on my Bass overdrive with an added tone barrier and a few minor modifications. It is designed in such a way that even with maximum distortion it is still easy to read and all frequencies sound. Overdrive has a classic LEVEL control for volume adjustment, DRIVE for distortion adjustment, BLEND for adjusting the ratio between clean and distorted signal, TONE for adjusting the tone and three-position switches ATTACK and GRUNT, with which you can independently set the degree of saturation of bass and high frequencies. It follows that the effect is very versatile in many styles. The whole effect is handmade and this also applies to the printed circuit board.
